ev.q: Florida Medical Examiners Commission (FMEC) data from the period 2003–2012 were analyzed for this report.
During 2010–2012, the number of drug overdose deaths decreased 16.7%, from 3,201 to 2,666
overdose death rates for opioid analgesics declined 27.0%, from 13.6 to 9.9 per 100,000 persons
The prescription drug overdose death rate decreased 23.2% to 11.1 per 100,000 persons
The decline in the overdose deaths from oxycodone (52.1%) exceeded the decline for other opioid pain relievers
The semiannual time trends in overdose rates for specific drugs indicate a steady decline beginning in 2011
